title: Hims Is Reaching 3 Million Member Milestone
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkev Tatavosianc reviews Hims & Hers as a potential high-upside disruptor in a healthcare industry he argues is ripe for disruption because customers are unhappy with incumbents — the opposite, he says, of payments, where Visa and Mastercard users are broadly satisfied. The growth numbers are strong: revenue up 40% to $753 million in the quarter, about 300,000 net new members taking the total close to 3 million, and international revenue up 17x year on year to $131 million after the Eucalyptus acquisition; management guides long term to $6.5 billion of revenue and $1.3 billion of adjusted EBITDA, against $2.6 billion of trailing revenue. The problems are profitability and returns: operating margin has fallen to 0.3% from about 8% a couple of years ago, and return on invested capital has reversed from about 35% in early 2025 to −8.4%, even though operating cash flow has stayed positive for multiple quarters. His discounted cash flow value is $26.90 against a market price of about $26 — a 3% gap he calls fairly valued — at a forward P/E of 37.6. His call is HIMS — CONDITIONAL_BUY: he reiterates his 14 September 'buying opportunity, medium conviction' rating but is waiting for a more attractive entry point, expecting the stock's volatility to offer one. First tracked Parkev call on HIMS, no flip.
